jobs.description:
A Snapshot of Your Day 

As a Business Controller (f/m/d) within the TI CP Business Controlling team, you serve as a trusted advisor to the Compression Service Region Europe & Africa, supporting a business spanning more than 35 countries. Working closely with regional leadership, finance teams, and operational stakeholders, you provide transparency on financial performance, drive forecasting and budgeting processes, and enable data-driven decision-making across a dynamic and diverse business environment.

Beyond core business controlling, you contribute to key strategic initiatives, including Enterprise Risk Management (ERM), sustainability reporting, central function controlling, and high-impact transformation projects. By combining financial expertise with business acumen and cross-functional collaboration, you help drive sustainable growth, operational excellence, and long-term value creation across the region.

How You’ll Make an Impact 

* Acting as the primary Finance Business Partner for the Compression Service Europe & Africa management team, providing financial transparency and actionable insights to support strategic decision-making
* Leading regional forecasting, budgeting, financial performance reviews, and financial planning & analysis activities across a network of more than 35 countries while identifying risks and opportunities
* Strengthening the Enterprise Risk Management framework and partnering with sustainability teams to support ESG initiatives, including EU Taxonomy reporting and compliance requirements
* Providing financial governance and controlling support for central functions, ensuring cost transparency, effective resource allocation, and sound financial governance
* Leading and supporting strategic projects and transformation initiatives, delivering financial insights, business case analyses, and value-creating recommendations
* Promoting process harmonization, digitalization, and automation to improve reporting quality, operational efficiency, and decision-making capabilities

What You Bring

* Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business Administration, or a related field; an MBA or other advanced degree is considered an advantage
* Proven experience in controlling, financial planning & analysis (FP&A), business partnering, or finance leadership within an international environment
* Strong expertise in forecasting, budgeting, financial reporting, variance analysis, performance management, and financial governance, ideally complemented by knowledge of Enterprise Risk Management, ESG, or sustainability reporting
* Proven analytical and strategic capabilities with the ability to translate complex financial data into actionable business recommendations and influence management decisions
* Hands-on experience with SAP, financial planning systems, business intelligence tools, and Microsoft Office, combined with excellent stakeholder management and collaboration skills in multicultural organizations
* Fluent English skills; additional language skills are considered an advantage 

About the Team

In our Business Functions we enable our organization to reach their targets by providing best-in class services and solutions in the areas of IT, HR, Finance, Real Estate, Strategy & Technology and more. 

Who is Siemens Energy? 

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100.000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.

Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.      

Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo

Our Commitment to Diversity 

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences. 

Rewards/Benefits 

* In addition to an attractive remuneration package in line with the market, you can expect an attractive employer-financed company pension scheme
* We also offer the opportunity to become a Siemens Energy shareholder
* We offer our employees the opportunity to work flexibly and remotely, and our inspiring offices provide space for collaboration and creativity
* The professional and personal development of our employees is very important to us. We provide them with the opportunities to learn and develop in a self-determined way, various attractive programmes and learning materials are available for this purpose
* In relation to the "compatibility of family and work", we have a wide range of offers, e.g. flexible working time models, childcare places at many locations, the possibility of trial part-time work or even a sabbatical  

We value equal opportunities and welcome applications from people with disabilities.

jobs.occupation: Research Associate (PhD Student) (m/f/d) in Computational Biology / Bioinformatics (Wissenschaftliche/r Mitarbeiter/in)
jobs.description:
...you're in the middle of it

Our **Department of Nephrology **and the Else Kroener-Fresenius-Center (EKFZ) provide excellent, state-of-the-art facilities to conduct interdisciplinary and computational research at the intersection of nephrology, immunology, and cardiovascular biology. We offer an attractive, supportive environment for modern science in molecular medicine and systems biology. We are looking for an ambitious, talented and highly motivated candidate to join our team.

The project that you are working on is embedded in a translational research program aiming to understand how the hematopoietic system crosslinks interactions between aging, cardiovascular, and kidney diseases. You will integrate multi-omic datasets to investigate molecular and cellular mechanisms in various organs and immune cells. By bridging single-cell resolution with global biobank scales, your work will help identify novel molecular mechanisms and therapeutic targets.

The candidate will be supervised and supported by experienced computational biologists, molecular biologists and clinicians. The project is designed to perform cutting-edge research with state-of-the-art methods and technologies.

Your Role:

- Analyze and integrate in-house and publicly available single-cell RNA-seq, single-cell ATAC-seq, and CITE-seq datasets
- Analyze large-scale genomic, proteomic and clinical data from the UK Biobank (UKB) and All of Us Research Program
- Develop and implement reproducible and scalable computational pipelines and workflows
- Collaborate closely with experimental biologists and clinicians in an interdisciplinary environment to define hypotheses and interpret results in a biological and clinical context
- Present research findings within the working group and at international conferences and publish in peer-reviewed journals and cumulate your findings in a doctoral thesis

... your skills are what we're looking for

- Master’s degree (or equivalent) in computational or molecular biology, bioinformatics, molecular medicine or a related field
- Proficiency in either R or Python for data analysis, statistics, and visualization.
- Previous experience with bioinformatic analysis of single-cell RNAseq analysis (Seurat/Scanpy) and/or genetic data
- A solid foundational understanding of molecular biology, genetics, or immunology, and a keen interest in human disease mechanisms.
- Keen interest in leveraging omics to elucidate disease mechanisms in cardiovascular and/or kidney disease and immunology
- Previous experience with reproducible coding practices and working in cloud environments is a plus.
- Solid understanding of statistics
- Willingness to understand and apply state-of-the-art computational tools and algorithms for single-cell, multi-omics and genetic analysis
- Very good verbal and written skills in English; German is an advantage but not required
- High motivation, ability to work independently as well as in an interdisciplinary team, excellent organizational and communication skills
- Due to legal regulations, valid proof of measles immunity / measles vaccination is required.

... you'll be offered a lot

- In addition to an attractive salary based on acollective agreement with an annual special payment, you benefit from long-term security through company pension schemes
- Internal and external training for your professional development
- Benefit from our attractive health offers. We offer regular online and face-to-face courses on nutrition, relaxation, sports and exercise
- We offer childcare in our daycare center (if you have any questions, please contact UKF-Familienservice), child care during holidays
- Free public transport in all Hessen (Free State Ticket Hessen)
- Uniklinik-Campus, Mensa, Cafés
- Insights: Instagram, YouTube, LinkedIn
- FAQ´s for new employees

**It's time to join our team! **

Kontakt: Dr. Simone-Franziska Glaser, Head of Research of the Else Kroener-Fresenius-Center
Mail: glaser@med.uni-frankfurt.de** **

Senior Auditor / R&D Quality Manager (m/f/d)

Stellen-ID: 22169
Standort: Frankfurt am Main

We are searching intelligent and innovative employees. If you are interested in working for a dynamic company with flat hierarchy, we look forward to receiving your application.

Your tasks:

- Plan and conduct clinical project audits, process audits, and supplier/vendor audits in accordance with GxP and regulatory requirements.
- Develop and maintain risk-based audit plans and study assessment strategies
- Evaluate audit findings, ensure proper documentation, and support CAPA development and follow-up
- Lead and manage quality escalations arising from clinical study activities
- Contribute to the development and maintenance of the Quality Management System, including SOPs, CAPA, deviations, and document control
- Provide quality consultation to Clinical Operations teams on study processes and quality-related topics
- Support qualification and evaluation of clinical service providers such as CROs, laboratories, couriers, and archiving services
- Deliver training on GCP, Good Clinical Laboratory Practice, and other quality-related topics

Your profile:

- University degree in a scientific or technical field such as Life Sciences, Pharmacy, or Medical Technology
- Several years of experience in Quality Management, Clinical Research, or auditing within a GxP/GCP-regulated environment
- Strong knowledge of regulatory requirements for medical devices and pharmaceuticals
- Proven experience in planning, conducting, and following up on internal and external audits
- Solid understanding of CAPA processes, deviation management, and document control systems
- Strong analytical skills and a structured, risk-based approach to quality oversight
- Excellent communication and advisory skills when working with cross-functional teams and external partners
- Very good command of English (written and spoken)

You can expect ...

- Experience in exciting and international projects
- Continuous salary development
- Da Vinci Corporate Benefits
- On-the-job training and language courses
- Appreciation, motivation and commitment

As a Supply Chain Analyst (d/f/m) employed in Hamburg Fuhlsbüttel, your role will focus on ensuring seamless operations in spare parts demand planning for customer requirements in the aviation industry. In collaboration with various internal departments such as Product Management, Customer Order Desk, Procurement, Quality, Warehouse, and Logistics, you will optimize workflows, ensure inventory availability, and actively contribute to process improvement initiatives. This is a full-time role within a workforce leasing arrangement, based in the strategic hub of Hamburg Fuhlsbüttel at Airbus.

Key responsibilities include:

- Analyzing and validating material demand forecasts based on customer orders, planning data, and client-specific inputs.
- Conducting procurement planning and ensuring the availability of inventory and materials.
- Acting as a central interface between stakeholders to maintain effective communication flow.
- Leveraging your expertise to support improvement and optimization projects within the supply chain processes.
- Ensuring adherence to deadlines and effective coordination of operational workflows to meet organizational goals.
VORAUSSSETZUNGEN:

Candidates applying for this position as a Supply Chain Analyst (d/f/m) should possess essential skills, qualifications, and experiences relevant to the aviation supply chain industry. Successful individuals will display strong organizational abilities, independent operational capabilities, and exceptional communication skills.

Required qualifications include:

- A Bachelor’s degree in Industrial Engineering, Supply Chain Management, or Logistics.
- Two years of professional experience in aerospace, supply chain, logistics, or data analysis/data management.
- Advanced practical knowledge in SAP and familiarity with Google Workspace tools.
- Proficiency in English at a negotiation level.
- Self-directed and structured working style with a high degree of accountability and resilience.
- Ability to meet deadlines while maintaining efficient workflow coordination.
- Commitment to integrating improvement measures within a results-driven framework.
Benefits:

- An unlimited employment contract
- 35-hour workweek
- 30 days of annual leave
- An annual salary of around 72.000 €
- An attractive package following the Equal Pay model
- Flexible handling of overtime through compensatory time-off or payment

jobs.occupation: Mechanical AIT Engineer (m/f/d) (Ingenieur/in - Luft- und Raumfahrttechnik)
jobs.description:
Your Tasks

- Timely creation of production documents for the fitters in the hall (work plans and production orders) and reporting on progress in planning meetings
- Reviewing parts lists (components and documents, 3D models).
- Review workstations
- Ensure optimal sequence of work steps
- Describe assembly steps taking into account procedural instructions
- Describe inspection steps taking into account procedural instructions
- Review required production aids (consumables, tools, production equipment)
- Coordinate the provision of materials (consumables and flight materials) at the workstations in close consultation with logistics
- Coordinate the provision of production equipment at the workstations in close consultation with the MGSE manager
- Bottlenecks in the availability of materials and production equipment
- Reviewing changes made by the design department and determining the need for modifications
- Instructing mechanical operators on complex tasks
- Analyzing change requests from fitters and quality reports and determining the need for modifications to work plans and parts lists
- Assessing the criticality of the need for modifications
- Documenting the need for modifications
- Implementing the changes
- Continuously analyzing the implemented changes and reporting to the specialist department to improve standard processes and templates
- Taking over assembly tasks in the clean room during peak periods
- Analyzing the progress of production orders and determining the need for changes to the planned times in the work plans
Your Qualifications

- You have a bachelor's degree in aviation, engineering, mechanical engineering, or are a technician (m/f/d)
- You have already gained 2 years of professional experience in production/manufacturing and/or technical documentation
- Good knowledge of MS Teams and PDM or SAP
- Good communication skills in cross-departmental collaboration.
- Independent working style, coordination and integration skills, assertiveness.
- Good knowledge of German and English
- Willingness to travel to follow the spacecraft to Environmental test und launch
- Willingness to take over mechanical activities on demand

Your Tasks

- Manage / Support cost engineering activities in different frames: - from feasibility studies to implementation proposals
- from specific subsystems to E2E systems
- for all domains, from Earth Observation to Telecommunication or Science Exploration
- for a variety of customers, but in particular ESA, EC, DLR, BW
- Provide costing expertise to the project team supporting the collection and validation of cost input, from internal company sources (departments) and external team members and suppliers
- Coordinate the cost engineering activities ensuring the delivery of the required cost analyses (respecting the customer and the company internal requirements) in quality and in time
- Support the cost optimisation activities granting that the different constraints and requirements are properly reflected (technical, programmatic, financial, georeturn, etc etc)
- Ensure that the cost analyses is reviewed according to the internal policies and is aligned within all the internal stakeholders (management, BD, project team, departments, procurement, controlling, etc)
- Contribute to the definition of the internal processes associated to cost engineering
- Contribute to the definition of the set of tools and templates associated to cost engineering
- Contribute to the organization and execution of in-house trainings on cost engineering
Your Qualifications

Hard requirements:

- Completed studies (Diploma or Master) in aerospace engineering or equivalent qualification (i.e. mechanical engineering, electrical engineering, physics)
- Advanced knowledge of the MS suite, especially MS Excel (VBA, PowerQuery, PowerPivot, PowerBI)
- Very good communication skills in oral / written English
- Experience in the space sector

Additional competences considered strong assets:

- Experience in the commercial space sector
- Knowledge of SQL language
- System engineering or Project Management background (2 years +)
- Cost engineering experience
- Very good communication skills in oral / written German
- Security Clearance

jobs.occupation: Associate Director Employment Law & Executive Governance (f/m/d) (Fachanwalt/-anwältin - Arbeitsrecht)
jobs.description:
STADA Arzneimittel GmbH
What to Expect

- In your role as Associate Director Employment Law & Executive Governance, you will draft and negotiate top management/executives' contracts (employment and termination agreements as well as other contractual arrangements) and closely coordinate with the corporate office.
- You will be responsible for the German headquarters but also for global executive employment law topics.You will advise and support Culture & People Regional Heads and executives in employment law matters and act as their primary point of contact.
- You will act as an interface to external law firms, coordinate mandates and ensure efficient collaboration.
- You will support and develop strategies on legal and financial matters with STADA's shareholders (e.g., transaction-related topics, special bonus payments).
- You will lead the Culture & People workstream for M&A transactions, including due diligence and post-deal integration.
- You will conduct compliance investigations related to Culture & People topics and derive appropriate measures.
- You will review, draft and update global benefit policies and ensure their legal compliance and practical implementation.

Who We Are Looking For

- In your role as a fully qualified lawyer under German law with a strong focus on employment law, you ideally have experience in handling and negotiating management/executive contracts and advising on M&A transactions.
- You have several years of professional experience in employment law in a comparable role, especially in drafting and negotiating service, employment and termination agreements for senior leaders.
- You present yourself with confidence, negotiate skillfully with internal stakeholders, external law firms and shareholders, and drive your topics with determination and a solution-oriented mindset.
- You are able to translate complex legal and financial matters into clear, understandable and pragmatic guidance for executives and Culture & People.
- You work in a structured and pragmatic way and enjoy shaping governance frameworks, global policies and compliance processes within the Culture & People function.
- You thrive in a modern, international and dynamic corporate culture and are used to fast-paced decision-making processes.
- You are fluent in German and English.

STADA Arzneimittel GmbH
What you can expect

- In your role as Executive Search Lead, you act as a strategic advisor to the CEO, CFO, CHRO and global functional leaders on talent availability, market trends and competitive insights.
- You lead global end-to-end Executive Search processes, including market mapping, longlist and shortlist creation, as well as direct outreach to senior leaders.
- You build and continuously develop global leadership talent pipelines for succession planning.
- You drive process excellence and ensure consistent global standards in Executive Search.
- You manage and evaluate external Executive Search partners, ensuring clear alignment with STADA's expectations and performance standards.
- You provide a premium, confidential candidate experience and represent STADA's leadership culture and EVP in all senior-level interactions.

Who we are looking for

- In your role, you bring 10-15 years of experience in Executive Search (in-house or with a top-tier search firm).
- You have a strong track record in hiring Executive roles and an extensive global network in Pharma, Consumer Health, FMCG or PE-backed environments.
- You are able to effectively influence and partner with senior stakeholders up to C-suite level.
- You have deep expertise in direct sourcing, market mapping and global talent intelligence.
- You work with a high level of discretion, speed and a strong ownership mindset.
- You have excellent communication skills in English; German is an advantage.
- You are used to working in fast-paced, international environments.
